title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic adds beta EDR monitoring inside Claude Cowork's local VM (Nov 3)
bullets.summary: Businesses can run endpoint-detection sensors (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Palo Alto Networks, Tanium and others) inside the Cowork VM and send activity to their own security console; Team/Enterprise on macOS and Windows, local VM only, no Anthropic charge during beta.
bullets.how: The Construct: security-visibility layer for our Cowork-run agents, worth knowing for the Mac runner. PRAGMA: a concrete answer to client 'what can the agent touch?' questions. Brand 9 Signs: indirect.

bullets.title: Claude plugins now connect automatically for Team and Enterprise, with Claude as trusted identity provider (Nov 3-4)
bullets.summary: Compatible plugins can authenticate through Claude as the identity provider, removing per-user connection steps. Source is Anthropic's ClaudeDevs post as relayed by The Neuron digest; details not independently confirmed.
bullets.how: The Construct: lowers friction for rolling plugins and skills across the agent fleet. PRAGMA: easier client onboarding for plugin-based deployments.

bullets.title: CrowdStrike ships an AI Kill Switch in Falcon Guardian (Nov 3)
bullets.summary: Lets security teams stop an agent's execution, block relaunches and restrict its network access, aimed at rogue or compromised agents.
bullets.how: The Construct: pattern to copy, an out-of-band stop control the agent cannot reach. PRAGMA: sellable guardrail concept for client agent deployments.

bullets.title: Revolut reportedly cuts AI coding costs about 90% by self-hosting GLM models instead of Claude (Nov 3)
bullets.summary: The British fintech moved coding workloads to self-hosted GLM models, claiming roughly a 10x cost reduction (The Register report).
bullets.how: The Construct: reinforces routing high-volume routines to the cheapest tier that passes its test. PRAGMA: a cost-comparison case study for client budgets; also a competitive signal against Claude-only stacks.

bullets.title: Scalekit AgentKit: one gateway to 30,000+ tools across 600 apps, free tier of 10,000 tool calls/month
bullets.summary: Agent-tool gateway handling auth and tool access for many SaaS apps behind a single integration; listed on Product Hunt.
bullets.how: The Construct: evaluate as a CRM/scheduling connector shortcut instead of building servers one by one. PRAGMA: possible client integration layer. Brand 9 Signs: maybe for CRM/quote tooling.

praxis_lesson: Agent safety is moving outside the agent: Cowork EDR sensors and CrowdStrike's kill switch both control agents from a layer they cannot read or edit, so build stop, audit and network limits into the host environment rather than the prompt. (Quiet day for MCP servers: nothing verified in video/CRM/DAM/signage; items rest on a daily digest and trade press, with the plugin auto-connect detail unconfirmed.)
